shape: national D2C clean-label snacks brand with strong web presence and JS-rendered own-site — tests the binder away from hyperlocal, into mainstream English-language D2C with crawler-aware web reality
notes: Held-out fixture, deliberate contrast to arjun-infra. Tests: (1) graceful handling of unreachable JS-rendered brand site — TWT runs a Next.js SPA whose homepage returns empty to WebFetch (validated 2026-05-20); §1 must reconstruct the claim from third-party brand-authored content (Scribd brochure, ZoomInfo, F6S, IRFU partnership press release) and use the WebFetch result honestly when it does return; (2) NON-hyperlocal locale — the depth dial should NOT trigger reference/hyperlocal.md and the three additional probes; verify the apprentice correctly identifies this as national and skips hyperlocal; (3) mainstream English-language register, contrast against arjun-infra's Telugu/Tenglish; (4) buyer voice at scale — TWT has real reviews on Amazon, Flipkart, social, plus active fitness-category discussion on YouTube and review blogs; §2 should be much richer than arjun-infra's thin signal; (5) brand identity with a real visual system — TWT has a distinctive design language (cream backgrounds, illustrative-photography mix, ingredient-transparency framing); §5 should detect a real coherent system vs arjun-infra's 'emerging identity, not yet a coherent system'; (6) cost-reality for D2C food/snacks vertical pan-India — different benchmark range than the hyperlocal real-estate range from arjun-infra; (7) the founder DID supply a URL upfront (contrast against arjun-infra where they didn't) — but still no reference images, so §4 still tests the gap-naming discipline.
